t: You're looking at Trinity Independent Chapel in Poplar, which began as an early Victorian church. A V-2 rocket destroyed it in the Second World War, and it was rebuilt in Modernist style. In the late 1990s it was sold to the Calvary Charismatic Baptist Church, which uses it as its Prayer Temple and international headquarters. The original architect was William Hosking, a writer and lecturer who shaped the growth of London in Victorian times. He became the first Professor of Architecture at King's College London.
